_note: Roles are the fixed contract; agents are swappable per role. A task may override any role's agent at creation time, after which the choice is frozen in state/tasks/<id>/state.json.

backend-dev.description: Implements NestJS/Prisma work in apps/api and shared contract in packages/types.

frontend-dev.description: Implements Next.js work in apps/web, mobile-first.

tester-e2e.description: Independent tester. Reads the cumulative diff, runs validation, never edits application source.

bug-fixer.description: Fixes defects listed in the tester's failure report.

reviewer.description: Reviews the cumulative diff for correctness, security and regressions.
